senders.title: List every legitimate sender
senders.detail: Include staff email, invoices, newsletters, CRM, website forms, ticketing and devices. Confirm who owns each service and which domain it signs with.

spf.title: Review SPF
spf.detail: Use one SPF record for the domain, include only verified senders, and stay within the 10-lookup limit. Get record values from your providers. Never replace a live record with a generic example.

dkim.title: Enable and verify DKIM
dkim.detail: Publish the TXT or CNAME entries supplied by each sending service, then enable signing there. Find the selector in the provider settings or s= in a message header. Check an actual message for dkim=pass and an aligned d= domain.

reports.title: Review DMARC reports
reports.detail: Choose a report service or mailbox you control. Confirm external reporting authorization where required. Review legitimate and unknown senders across a representative business cycle. dmark does not receive or host aggregate reports in this release.

dmarc.title: Plan DMARC enforcement
dmarc.detail: For a new setup, monitor before enforcing. Preserve any existing protection while checking senders. DMARC passes when aligned SPF or aligned DKIM succeeds. Progress toward quarantine or reject only after real mail and reports support the change; include subdomain policy in the review.

bimi.title: Optional: prepare BIMI
bimi.detail: BIMI adds branding, not a replacement for authentication. Review DMARC enforcement, a compliant SVG logo served over HTTPS, and the receiving provider’s VMC/CMC requirements. Certificates may cost money and inbox display depends on the provider. The scanner checks default._bimi only and does not validate the logo or certificate.

states.invalid: The record is incomplete, duplicated or has conflicting tags. Review it with your provider.
